rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the hard material from an animal's tusks.

example.english: This bracelet is made of ivory.
example.traditional: 呢條手鏈係用象牙整嘅。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 sau2 lin6 hai6 jung6 zoeng6 ngaa4 zing2 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the creamy off-white color, rather than for the material itself.

example.english: I want to paint the room ivory.
example.traditional: 我想將間房髹成象牙色。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 gaan1 fong2 jau1 sing4 zoeng6 ngaa4 sik1

rows.note: Use this for piano keys generally when the musical-instrument context is clear.

example.english: When learning piano, the first step is learning the ivory keys.
example.traditional: 學彈鋼琴，第一步係認清琴鍵。
example.jyutping: hok6 taan4 gong1 kam4 dai6 jat1 bou6 hai6 jing6 cing1 kam4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when the sense is specifically the white piano keys contrasted with the black keys.

example.english: When playing piano, do not just press the ivory keys with your left hand; play the black keys too.
example.traditional: 彈琴時，左手唔好淨係按白鍵，要配埋黑鍵。
example.jyutping: taan4 kam4 si4 zo2 sau2 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 on3 baak6 gin6 jiu3 pui3 maai4 hak1 gin6
